name: v0.4.1
body:
## What's Changed
* docs(benchmarks): the English-vs-rest table has three columns, so every number sat under the wrong header by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1024
* docs(confidence): answer_confidence describes the clamped temperature, not the fitted one by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1026
* docs(mcp): the environment table names LAYA_API_KEY by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1027
* docs(dotnet): the Instructions remark names the escaping Python stopped doing by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1029
* docs(benchmarks): sv moves down in the refreshed sweep, so not every large mover moves up by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1030
* fix(fixtures): skip predict_golden when the checkpoint beside the graph is absent by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1031
* docs(guardrails): Document prompt_injection limitation on document-shaped text (#781) by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1032
* docs(hooks): eight pages describe a dispatch the code does not do by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1033
* docs(readme): seven return shapes and feature lists that do not match the code by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1034
* fix(choice): sort criteria keys for order-invariant option rendering by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1035
* docs(dotnet): six claims in the .NET README and MODELS that the SDK contradicts by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1037
* docs(http-api): five tables that disagree with the endpoint they document by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1038
* docs(integrations): min_confidence flags the answer, it does not withhold it by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1039
* docs(evals): the metric table does not match a default run by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1040
* docs(benchmarks): the laya typed-decisions row must round its committed file, like the row below it by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1041
* docs(mcp): a remote batch is one request per item for every batch, not only a heterogeneous one by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1042
* docs(contributing): the extras list must name all nine, starting with… by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1043
* docs(docker): the GPU image installs cu130 wheels, not CUDA 12.8 by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1044
* fix(evals): write redirected output as utf-8 by @plox-sumit in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1045
* feat(java): dispatch router lifecycle hooks, and add AsyncHook by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1046
* feat(serve): register extra checkpoints from LAYA_EXTRA_MODELS by @jxoesneon in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1047
* fix(serve): serve again after the app's lifespan restarts by @hemanthrayuduu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1049
* fix(structured): let Router.decide_batch pin a checkpoint by @hemanthrayuduu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1050
* fix(onnx): answer single-option questions instead of failing in TopK by @hemanthrayuduu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1051
* fix(train): move the model to the device before the base evaluation by @FerryQ in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1052
* feat(java): language routing, presets and the embedding shortlist by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/938
* feat(train): print the optimizer-update budget before a run by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1014
* fix(ts): reject impossible min_confidence bucket keys in both TypeScript trees by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1015
* docs(finetune): add the #963 positive-control and multi-seed diagnostic by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1016
* refactor(finetune): converge the Kaggle DDP path on shared training primitives by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1017
* docs(window): floor and room binding on two prose sites that teach it by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1018
* docs(reference): document the pre-run request sizing surface by @Bruce-Yii in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1019
* fix(dotnet): synchronize EnsureStrippedTokenizer to prevent race cond… by @LEVELING2108 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1020
* docs(hooks): run_id is shared by the predict events, not by on_load/on_evict by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1021
* docs(mcp): both batch rows must name every call argument their handler takes by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1022
* docs(readme): routing metadata is five keys, not the three the page showed by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1023
* docs(mcp): the laya_status row names the per-checkpoint device map by @keemsisi in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1028

## New Contributors
* @jxoesneon made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1047
* @FerryQ made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1052

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

## [6.1.0](https://github.com/morluto/rea/compare/rea-agents-6.0.0...rea-agents-6.1.0) (2026-10-09)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **hopper:** Hopper regex mode uses ECMAScript Unicode syntax instead of Python re. Matching runs in a cancellable worker with a five-second deadline; literal mode keeps Unicode casefold matching.
* **hopper:** remove set_current_document. Use open_binary to switch targets; document arguments are scoped to the active target.

name: v0.8.143
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.143

Released on 2026-10-08.

Distributed renders of long videos start much sooner. Each chunk now extracts only the video frames it shows, instead of the plan step extracting every frame up front. On AWS Lambda, a 26-minute clip now plans in about 20 seconds instead of over 6 minutes.

This release also fixes WebVTT caption parsing, makes `hyperframes check` and lint more accurate, and fixes SDK save and patch edge cases.

## Fixes

- **Player:** Honor runtime discovery and source in embeds ([2dd708e0a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2dd708e0a214fa4b8bffadc6a13c7ff55ef954a2), [#5244](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5244)).
- **SDK:** Preserve unquoted escapes in inline styles ([2df897aa4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2df897aa43bcafbdb2662b1f8d2ade6b379b44d0), [#5246](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5246)).
- **CLI:** Normalize the audio passage the clip plays ([1449d0d2a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1449d0d2a1e4026dc353ca5560d89fbb365e714b), [#5222](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5222)).
- **CLI:** Preserve literal WebVTT cue text ([1fac5fb29](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1fac5fb29d1588aa2af4cc6f2307f110ac3218f0), [#5236](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5236)).
- **CLI:** Bound timeline bars for negative media starts ([83b2f5608](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/83b2f5608f55bc7312061c9164429bf570a7b531), [#5239](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5239)).
- **CLI:** Audit text beneath transparent composition boxes ([b32ce10b7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b32ce10b77ecd76a8a9157aaa12d66cc7b76d243), [#5202](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5202)).
- **CLI:** Recognize ancestor gradient text masks ([f802aedb5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f802aedb5b32e71bd3664cce55def95b54ca763b), [#5207](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5207)).
- **CLI:** Route timeline project directories to inspection ([ee64ebe33](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ee64ebe33815e451f9539738f7118a3f1c54ac0c), [#5240](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5240)).
- **CLI:** Honor authored durations when listing compositions ([1094b8ef0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1094b8ef0e764c9f4806aff2e0017ed6f82d3719), [#5265](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5265)).
- **CLI:** Preserve speaker labels in WebVTT cue text ([7faff8154](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7faff8154f86892509f9997a45ef389f572fd3e7), [#5233](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5233)).
- **Lint:** Parse inline script type and source attributes ([9111d9f97](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9111d9f97e41a0275b5476dbf1681ed9fdb80354), [#5220](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5220)).
- **Lint:** Read attribute values with the HTML parser ([b4c847aca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b4c847aca2c12c6d516ddf90b8c966a54bb73b79), [#5209](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5209)).
- **Lint:** Detect optional managed media calls ([c03aa9224](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c03aa9224d59353dcf5e473b943988971fc11c69), [#5210](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5210)).
- **Core:** Seek current dotLottie players by frame ([c94d99218](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c94d9921888f8e5df64c9f028f9cce553941efab), [#5275](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5275)).
- **Slideshow:** Validate nested hotspot entries ([00729a566](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00729a566dd88615eaa1a08a10d83e1e69f6d14e), [#5211](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5211)).
- **Core:** Associate GIF delays with their image frames ([e57d8178c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e57d8178c438a7667c4d68d70acc094acdd01157), [#5272](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5272)).
- **CLI:** Validate the complete TTS speed argument ([5a7ada63b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a7ada63bfe9891168ea354d7a7c8b6c2db84ca4), [#5264](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5264)).
- **CLI:** Preserve caption text inside script blocks ([c9c9f4d36](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9c9f4d363237f5795f0f2114865cf7b476a928d), [#5226](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5226)).
- **CLI:** Retain WebVTT timestamps before cue settings ([f5aeecdbf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f5aeecdbf4b43f11cd084984a754e8a433d1dba8), [#5224](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5224)).

- **Producer:** Distributed renders now extract each video's frames inside the chunks that show it, instead of all at once in the plan step ([04f2bcd67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/04f2bcd67a6faa9e9c2e1ed3ba6958f3db702717), [#5290](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5290)).

name: v0.8.142
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.142

Released on 2026-10-08.

The CLI now accepts a HeyGen access token handed over by a host app, so the app can sign it in without saving credentials. If your shell already exports `HEYGEN_ACCESS_TOKEN`, the CLI now uses it ahead of `~/.heygen/credentials`.

## Features

- **CLI:** Accept host-managed HeyGen access tokens ([cf1b04bb7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cf1b04bb71662b20a236bb8d0e80499d541cae8f), [#5177](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5177)).

name: Happy CLI v1.2.6-beta.1
body:
- **Offline reconnect fix:** a session started while the Happy server was unreachable now receives messages, Stop and kill from the app after it reconnects (acp, gemini, agy, openclaw). Thanks @rophy (#1858, fixes #1857).
- **Agent SDK 0.3.295 (Claude Code 2.1.295):** Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 now get the full 1M context window, and `[1m]` models no longer fail on gateways, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry that refuse the context-1m beta.
- **Permission mode:** when no permission mode is picked, Claude Code's own settings (`defaultMode`) now decide, instead of always starting in manual approval.

name: Happy CLI v1.2.6-beta.0
body:
## Happy CLI v1.2.6-beta.0

- **Opus 5.5 in app-started sessions**: the Claude Agent SDK floor is raised to `^0.3.283` (bundled Claude Code 2.1.283). Older bundled Claude Code (below 2.1.280) rejects Opus 5.5 with an API 400. (#1881)
- **Clearer error for an outdated bundled Claude Code**: when Claude reports a model is too new for it, the session message now says to update Happy (`npm i -g happy@latest`); `claude update` does not replace the copy bundled with Happy. (#1881)
- Session metadata parsing accepts the new optional `systemKey` and `depth` fields from newer Happy Agents (happy-wire).

name: v5.1.0
body:
Ponytail no longer writes its name into your code. Deliberate shortcuts are now marked with a neutral comment, `shortcut: <the limit>, <when to upgrade>`, and `/ponytail-debt` still finds the old `ponytail:` ones, so nothing in your ledger gets lost. Want another word, or none at all? Say so in your project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md and run `/ponytail-debt <your word>`.

Measured against 5.0.0 before shipping: same number of markers, same pass rate, same cost.


## What's Changed
* feat: neutral shortcut: marker instead of the ponytail: brand in code comments by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1068
* chore: release v5.1.0 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1069

name: v18.8.7
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added routing-session cleanup for OpenAI Responses and Codex while preserving shared provider fallbacks ([#14334](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14334) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude Haiku 5.5 requests silently enabling adaptive thinking when reasoning is off, on native Bedrock (main and helper calls) and the Anthropic API; conversations whose earlier effort controls rule out disabled thinking fall back to lowest-effort adaptive thinking instead of failing ([#14996](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14996) by [@bse-ai](https://github.com/bse-ai)).
- Fixed `/session pin` being ignored when every stored account is quota-blocked, which routed the next request to a different exhausted account instead of the pinned one ([#14997](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14997)).
- Fixed `minimax-code-cn` sessions staying pinned to a key whose Token Plan quota is exhausted (`用量上限` 429) instead of rotating to a sibling credential ([#15053](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15053)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added built-in CoralBricks support with `/login`, live model discovery, per-model reasoning levels and off controls, and bundled offline fallbacks. ([#14146](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14146) by [@ryan-brosas](https://github.com/ryan-brosas))
- Added `gen:models --provider <id>` to update one provider without changing other providers' catalog snapshots. ([#14146](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14146) by [@ryan-brosas](https://github.com/ryan-brosas))

### Fixed

- Fixed Claude Haiku 5.5 thinking Off to request explicitly disabled thinking on every host serving its adaptive thinking ([#14996](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14996) by [@bse-ai](https://github.com/bse-ai)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added automated release binary publication to build.stencil.so
- Added OSC 7501 program status reporting: terminals and agent inboxes that support it now show whether omp is working, waiting on your answer or approval (with the question), done, or failed (with the error), without parsing the window title. Turn it off with `terminal.programStatus`.
- Added title cards (icon and short code) to `/rename`: the title model picks one for a title you type, or for a generated title when the session has no card yet; `title.icons: boring` keeps renamed titles plain.
- Grammars for less common languages (Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, PHP, Haskell, Verilog, and others) are now downloaded on first use for code summaries, block context, `ast_grep`, `ast_edit`, and TTSR rules; offline, files in those languages are skipped with a note instead of failing. `PI_GRAMMARS_URL` overrides the download location.
- Added `bash.gitGuard` (default off) for checkouts shared by concurrent agents: the bash tool refuses `git stash`, `git reset --hard` or to another commit, and `git checkout`/`switch`/`restore` that would overwrite working-tree files unless a merge or rebase conflict is being resolved; unstaging stays allowed, and commands are judged as they actually run, including inside substitutions, functions, and after `cd`.

### Changed

- Updated `write` tool error message to mention local:// scratch support
- Web search now tells the agent about its X post operators (`site:x.com`, `from:<handle>`) when you are logged in to xAI, so questions about reactions on X reach X search.
- Reduced memory retained after merging unchanged discovered and cached models ([#14252](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14252) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- The default `smol` model now prefers Claude Haiku 5.5 when it is available.
- Automatic session titles now start when the agent's reply begins rather than when you submit, so a slow-thinking first reply gets a card title (icon and code) instead of a plain fallback title.
- `read file.jsonl?q=…` keeps the other lines' results when a line before the last fails and shows jq's error ahead of them, instead of failing the read; anything else the query wrote to stderr, such as `debug` output, now leads the result too ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Title card icons now picture each session's specific subject instead of a generic bug, flask, speedometer, gear, or terminal, or the project's language logo, so sessions in the same project are easier to tell apart.
- Agents whose tool list omits `write` but still get it to run `xd://` tools can now also write `local://` files (reports, notes) outside plan mode; working-tree writes stay blocked.
- Added `worktree.onStart` and `worktree.onExit` settings to start each session in its own worktree and clean it up on exit ([#14908](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14908) by [@gitpushoriginmaster](https://github.com/gitpushoriginmaster))
- Added `speech.speed` and `tts.localSpeed` settings (0.5–2.5, default 1) to speed up or slow down local Kokoro speech for live vocalization and the `tts` tool / `omp say`, plus an `omp say --speed` flag; ACP voice clients find both settings and their presets in `speech.models.list` ([#5868](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/5868))
- `omp update` and the startup update notice leave an omp installed by another app (Tern) to that app instead of replacing its files.
- The startup update notice no longer appears when omp runs from a source checkout.

### Fixed

- Reduced memory growth after one-shot side requests without interrupting ongoing conversations ([#14334](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14334) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Fixed sessions staying untitled when you interrupted the first reply to send a queued steer message.
- Fixed browser downloads saving into another tab's `downloads` folder, and `tab.waitForDownload()` saving into the system Downloads folder once another tab closed; each tab in a Chromium omp launched or spawned now saves into its own, iframe downloads included. In those browsers a download no tab tracks (started by a page omp did not open, or finishing after its tab closed) now keeps Chromium's GUID file name instead of its suggested name; connected and relay browsers keep real file names ([#14544](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14544) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser calls in relay mode failing with "The browser relay … is out of date" after an omp upgrade until the old relay was killed by hand; omp now restarts a relay it started itself under an older version ([#14416](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14416) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `/rename` without a title dropping the session's title card (icon and short code) ([#14980](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14980))
- Fixed title cards showing the emoji instead of the Nerd Font icon when the model misremembered the icon's name: dashes for underscores (`nf-md-text-box`), the wrong icon set (`nf-md-spinner` for `nf-fa-spinner`), or reordered, missing, or extra words (`nf-md-test` for `nf-md-test_tube`).
- Fixed `omp update` ignoring the `update.channel` setting: canary users were checked against stable releases, and `--canary`/`--stable` were never remembered.
- Fixed interrupting a reply to send a queued steer message briefly showing omp as idle (title, progress, working indicator) before the steer ran; RPC and SDK clients also no longer see a final `agent_end` for that interrupt.
- Fixed browser tab recordings and video frame/contact-sheet extraction creating `omp-browser-recording-*` and `omp-video-*` scratch directories in your working directory instead of the system temp directory.
- Fixed edit snapshots retaining excess history when metadata or displayed-line provenance grows; the 64 MiB snapshot budget now counts UTF-8 bytes, so CJK- and emoji-heavy files keep fewer versions ([#14975](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14975) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed proactive linking freezing the host for seconds per stored memory on large banks; a memory's graph links are now written in one commit instead of one per link ([#14998](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14998)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `wasmGrammarFor` for tree-sitter grammars loaded as WebAssembly on demand from `<natives dir>/grammars`, and `missingGrammars` on `astGrep`/`astEdit` results naming languages skipped because their grammar is not installed.

### Changed

- Reduced syntax-highlighting startup work by bundling the complete precompiled grammar set ([#14104](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14104) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Changed standalone binaries to embed each native addon as its own deterministic zstd frame instead of a timestamped gzip tarball, making binaries smaller.
- Updated the shell's built-in `jq` to jaq 3.1.1, which `jq --version` now reports ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed the built-in `jq` erroring where jq returns `null` (`.a.b` over `{}`, `.[0]` over `null`) and lacking `IN`, `input_filename`, `input_line_number` and `--unbuffered` ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the built-in `jq` reading each file operand separately: `-s` now slurps them into one array and `input` reads on into the next file, as in jq ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the built-in `jq` stopping at the first input that fails and rejecting `"021"` and `"+1"` in `tonumber`, where jq does neither; a run that reported a failing input is never shortened by the output minimizer, even when it exits 0 ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the built-in `jq`'s `halt_error` printing its message to stdout; like jq, it now goes to stderr ([#14659](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Shrank the native addon by about 77 MB: only 17 common tree-sitter grammars are linked in, and the other 39 languages load WebAssembly grammars from the grammar directory, treated as unsupported until installed.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added cache-release hooks for TUI components and tool cards, allowing extensions to discard derived render data without rebuilding content ([#13632](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13632) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Changed

- Subagent "Submit Result" cards now show the submitted result (its fields as a tree, or the report text), the section it fills, and why a submission was rejected, instead of only "Result submitted.".
- Reduced memory held by retired transcript history in long sessions ([#13632](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13632) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).

### Fixed

- Reduced memory retained by discarded TSP images and previews ([#14336](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14336) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Fixed startup capability probes printing as text in the prompt (e.g. `25a1;stsp;q;{…}pppppp`) on terminals that cannot parse them, such as macOS Terminal.app.
- Fixed the `/resume` picker flashing while a search runs over a large session history: background fuzzy matches now land in one update instead of reordering the list dozens of times per keystroke.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Added `getNativeGrammarsDir()`, where the native addon loads downloaded tree-sitter grammars from (`~/.omp/natives/grammars`).

### Fixed

- Fixed the virtual terminal misreading private CSI sequences such as kitty keyboard `CSI < u` and modifyOtherKeys `CSI > 4;1 m` as cursor restores or text styling, which garbled replayed PTY output.


## What's Changed

* Build the combined syntax grammar artifact ahead of time by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14104
* fix(coding-agent): release completed one-shot provider state by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14334
* fix(tui): release discarded native image blobs by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14336
* fix(ai,catalog): honor Claude Haiku 5.5 thinking Off by @bse-ai in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14996
* fix(ai): tried explicit session pin first when every account is blocked by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14999
* fix(mnemopi): batched proactive-link graph writes in one transaction by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15005
* feat(coding-agent): add Kokoro speaking-rate settings for vocalization and local TTS by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15042
* fix(coding-agent): advertise speech speed settings in the ACP speech catalog by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15045
* fix(coding-agent): restart an outdated browser relay that omp started itself by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14416
* fix(browser): save each tab's downloads into its own folder by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14544
* fix(builtins): port jq to jaq 3.1.1 and close the jq gaps agents hit by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14659
* Release derived render caches when transcript entries retire by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13632
* fix(edit): count retained snapshot allocations with shared provenance by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14975
* feat(catalog): add CoralBricks provider with /login flow by @ryan-brosas in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14146

name: v18.8.6
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- Added support for warm-cache-aware conversation pruning, keeping pruned history within the model’s prompt-cache lookback window while preserving Anthropic prompt-cache efficiency.
- Added `AgentLoopConfig.hasQueuedAsides` (also available on `Agent`) to allow interruptible waits to detect queued asides without consuming them or signaling other tools.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed Google Gemini and Cloud Code Assist (Antigravity) requests failing when tool schemas contain unsupported JSON Schema keywords or fields that allow multiple types.
- Fixed auth broker account selection and usage-limit enforcement to consistently use the selected account’s quota when multiple accounts are present.
- Fixed Anthropic-family model streaming so encoded marker tokens are decoded correctly in text, tool-call updates, partial messages, and completed tool calls.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added prompt-cache lookback support for Claude models across all hosts, including the public `prompt-cache-lookback` catalog axis and `resolvePromptCacheLookback` API.

### Fixed

- Fixed model discovery when providers publish models before they are recognized by the catalog; unsupported models are now skipped with a warning so other available models remain discoverable.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added per-session Git worktree support with `worktree.onStart` and `worktree.onExit` settings to create an isolated worktree for each session and clean it up when the session ends.
- Expanded xAI web search with X post search, including X-only and author-specific queries, author exclusions, date and recency filters, and automatic xAI routing when credentials are available.
- Added xAI-powered reading of X posts, threads and replies, profiles, searches, and hashtags when logged in, replacing the unavailable Nitter mirrors.

### Changed

- Web search now prefers an authenticated `xai-oauth` login over an `xai` API key when both are available, unless `modelProviderOrder` specifies a different order.

### Fixed

- Fixed judge-gated features continuing to use a stale model chain after switching judge roles.
- Improved Anthropic prompt-cache reuse when pruning tool results from long conversations.
- Fixed resumed Claude sessions losing earlier thinking context and prompt-cache reuse when extensions or MCP tools were registered before the first message.
- Fixed subagent advisors configured with `@advisor` using the built-in `slow` model instead of the configured advisor role.
- Fixed the `/switch` command and alternate model picker crashing when stored model speed statistics contained an unnamed model.
- Fixed `lsp` and `generate_image` attempting to read FIFO, terminal, or unbounded device paths, which could hang or exhaust memory.
- Fixed aside messages from extensions being blocked behind a running wait operation.
- Fixed extensions importing `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/native/*` failing to load in compiled `omp` binaries.
- Fixed raw token markers appearing instead of Nerd Font icons in Anthropic idle recaps, `/btw` and `/omfg` replies, and streaming previews.
- Fixed sessions moved with `/wt` disappearing from resume lists; sessions in Git worktrees now remain discoverable and can be resumed or relocated if their worktree was removed.
- Fixed live config reload ignoring edits made during startup or right after a config symlink was retargeted, until the next unrelated edit.

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- Improved rendering performance for streaming long Markdown lists while preserving nested items, numbering, and reference links.

### Fixed

- Added package exports for the native Tern/TSP modules, allowing extensions in compiled `omp` binaries to import them.
- Fixed the Tern `/model` picker's Roles tab so typing and Backspace consistently edit the search field without triggering role commands.
- Fixed the session picker so sessions retain and display their directory when switching between the current folder and all-project views.


## What's Changed
* fix(agent): stop tool-result pruning from re-writing the whole Anthropic cache behind many small turns by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14751
* fix(coding-agent): keep resumed Claude sessions' thinking and cache when tools register before the first message by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14754
* fix(ai): stop broker clients judging an account by a sibling's usage when its own fetch fails by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14904
* fix(coding-agent): resolve @advisor subagent advisor against owner roles by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14972
* fix(judgment): invalidate the cached judge role chain when settings change by @alnaggar-dev in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14861
* feat(coding-agent): add worktree.onStart and worktree.onExit settings by @gitpushoriginmaster in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14908
* fix(coding-agent): skipped null model_perf keys that crashed the model picker by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14787
* fix(lsp,image): refuse FIFOs and devices instead of hanging on them by @DrFaustus-vic in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14730
* fix(agent): end an interruptible wait when an aside is queued by @mgpai22 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14731
* fix(ai): strip uniqueItems and unsupported schema keywords for Google and CCA by @jwaldrip in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14766
* fix(tui): register pi-tui native/* subpaths for compiled-binary extensions by @clasalle-lila in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14835
* Make long streamed lists incremental by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13701

## New Contributors

name: Reasonix Studio v2.33.0
body:
本版把图标栏移到窗口最左侧并加入反馈入口与三档显示方式，新增模型选择器搜索与分组、HTML 文件页面预览和「视觉效果」节能档，补齐终端界面的多个按键，并修复队列编辑、回退重发、反馈截图和带天空主题包长时间占用显卡的问题。

## 新增

- 图标栏移到窗口最左边，底部新增带未读角标的「发送反馈」入口；外观页「图标栏」改为始终显示（默认）／仅侧栏折叠时显示／从不显示，立即生效 (#12428)
- 输入框的模型选择器带搜索框（输入即过滤，回车选第一项，Esc 关闭），按服务商分组并固定显示分组标题，条目改为单行，当前模型保留勾选，声明可读图的模型带「读图」标记 (#12442)
- 工作台文件浏览器里打开 `.html`/`.htm` 文件时，标签页新增「预览」视图（默认）：按网页打开，同目录的样式、脚本、图片照常加载，文件变化后自动刷新，未保存的草稿不会被覆盖 (#12443)
- 设置的外观页「高级外观」新增「视觉效果」：完整（默认）／节能。节能档去掉磨砂玻璃、动态天空和颗粒，布局不变；只作用于本机，立即生效 (#12448)
- 终端界面的工具审批和计划审批卡片支持用 `j`/`k` 和 `Ctrl+N`/`Ctrl+P` 移动光标 (#12419 by @xxoingr)
- 终端界面的提问卡片支持 `j`/`k` 上下移动、`h`/`l` 在问题之间左右切换 (#12420 by @xxoingr)
- 终端界面的 `/mcp` 面板支持 `l`/右方向键进入服务的工具列表，`h`/左方向键返回或关闭面板，`q` 直接关闭 (#12421 by @xxoingr)
- 终端界面在开启应用内鼠标捕获时，没有选中文字的右键会粘贴剪贴板里的文字，与 1.x 一致，通过 SSH 连接时仍显示原有提示；输入框隐藏时不粘贴 (#12436 by @xxoingr)
- 终端界面在回合运行中按 `Ctrl+Enter`，把输入框内容作为引导发送，效果与 `Ctrl+S` 相同，在下一个工具边界送达；空闲时按它不做任何事，不会把想换行的草稿提交出去 (#12437 by @xxoingr)

## 变更

- 打开会话窗格时，MCP、改动、上下文和队列不再在状态返回前后各读取一次；在测试夹具里这四项各由两次降为一次，实际耗时变化尚未实测 (#12344 by @KHG420)
- Go 工具链升到 1.26.9、网络库 `golang.org/x/net` 升到 v0.60.0，清除漏洞扫描对本程序报告的 11 项可达漏洞，扫描结果为 0；只影响构建，没有源码改动 (#12446)

## 修复

- 带天空的主题包不再让显卡持续满载：天空画布降到每秒 15 帧，窗口不可见或失焦时停绘，面板模糊改为更实的底色。RTX 3060 上空闲占用从 9.3% 降到 1.0%，集成显卡未实测 (#12448)
- 连续点击队列里两条的「编辑」时，先点的那条较晚返回，不再覆盖后点那条的编辑框和未保存的草稿；较早的拒绝提示也不再盖掉已打开的编辑框 (#12411 by @KHG420)
- 编辑已发送的消息并重发时，如果回退失败，编辑框保留修改的文字并在原处显示错误，可直接重试，不再关闭编辑框后什么都没发出去 (#12426 by @KHG420)
- 反馈截图还在读取时提交反馈再点「再写一条」，上一条的截图不再混进下一条反馈 (#12423 by @KHG420)
- 打开反馈对话框后，焦点偶尔停在标签页上而不进入正文输入框的问题已修复 (#12439)
- 已发送消息里粘贴或上传并保存的图片现在显示预览；图片读取失败时保留预览框并显示「图片不可用」，竖图不再撑出预览框 (#12332 by @KHG420)
- 标题栏的设备面板在云端访问离线时，会区分说明是未登录、中继不可达还是中继拒绝，不再一律显示为未登录 (#12429 by @icebear02)
- 终端界面输入框里调出了多行历史条目后，上下键可以继续往更早的条目翻，不再卡在该条目的第一行 (#12435 by @xxoingr)
- 项目里声明的 MCP 服务启用后，若命令、参数、环境变量或网址被改动，会回到「待授权」并显示将要启动的命令；升级后已启用的项目服务会再询问一次 (e2d8eba20, GHSA-j7r7-jh9q-wrq2)

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@xxoingr、@KHG420、@icebear02

* feat(studio): icon rail at the far left, with feedback and three display modes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/12428

body:
### Patch Changes

- 61cf806: Keep the rest of AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md untouched when `ctx7 remove` deletes the Context7 rule section; only the seam left by the removed section is normalized.

name: @upstash/context7-sdk@0.5.1
body:
### Patch Changes

- 8861808: Honor request timeouts and cancellation while waiting for an asynchronous authentication token provider.

name: @upstash/context7-mcp@4.2.1
body:
### Patch Changes

- c30f279: Verify OAuth JWT access tokens from the authorization server (Clerk) strictly on the hosted HTTP transport: signature, issuer, a `typ` of `at+jwt`, expiry with a minute of clock tolerance, and the token's `aud`. Clerk ID tokens and session JWTs, which share the issuer, now get HTTP 401. The audience is compared against the `RESOURCE_URL` origin, `/mcp` and `/mcp/oauth` (override with `MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES`); `MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE_ENFORCEMENT` defaults to `observe`, which admits a mismatch and logs the OAuth client ID and audience (once per token every ten minutes), and `required` answers 401. These JWTs count as `oauth` in authentication telemetry, a token the Context7 API rejects on a tool call is challenged on the next request, and a rejected OAuth token now stays rejected in the per-replica cache for ten minutes instead of thirty seconds.
- dd48abc: query-docs now sets `isError` on its result when the documentation request fails (invalid library ID, API or network error), so clients that branch on `isError` no longer treat the error text as documentation.
- 6116042: Report the actual assigned HTTP port when `--port 0` requests an ephemeral port.

name: Clash Verge Rev v2.5.8
body:
## v2.5.8
🐞 修复问题 - 修复系统托盘代理组行不显示延迟、超时项与未测过项无法区分的问题 - 修复不同订阅源的同名节点测速和延迟显示指向错误节点的问题 - 修复端口设置混淆保存值与运行值、输入无效时缺少提示的问题 - 修复已有内核进程阻止启动时缺少多语言说明和处理建议的问题 - 修复从开始菜单再次打开应用后，窗口反复弹出并提示启动失败的问题 - 修复多个代理集合包含同名节点时，代理组中的节点变灰并显示 ambiguous、无法选择的问题 - 修复手动更新时重复下载后台已下载的安装包、启动时选「稍后」后每次启动都重新下载的问题 - 修复下载更新时镜像缓慢或卡住不会切换下载地址、点击「取消」无法中止下载的问题 - 修复关闭「自动检查更新」后，启动时仍弹出已下载更新的安装提示的问题 - 修复从 Dock 退出、注销或关机时，应用可能长时间卡住无法退出的问题 - 修复宽窗口下「订阅」页每行显示过多卡片，导致配置名称被截断的问题 **🖥️ Windows** - 修复 Windows 升级后因文件权限异常无法启动、需要手动清理配置的问题 - 修复 Windows 服务启动类型被改为手动后，软件启动卡住约两分钟的问题，并提供一键修复 - 修复 Windows 长时间运行后，托盘菜单点击无响应的问题 **🍎 macOS** - 修复 macOS 关闭 TUN 或退出后，系统 DNS 仍停留在 `114.114.114.114` 导致无法解析域名的问题 **🖥️/🍎 Windows/macOS** - 修复 Windows/macOS 打开系统托盘菜单时，节点延迟与自动选择状态未刷新的问题

name: v2.11.23 — Skill and tooling fixes from @rudycelekli: corrected platform facts, sounder math in the…
body:
Skill and tooling fixes from @rudycelekli: corrected platform facts, sounder math in the finance and testing guidance, and validator fixes.

- **Platform facts:**
  - **schema** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): FAQ rich results ended in 2026, and HowTo and the sitelinks search box were retired earlier; Schema.org vocabulary is now kept separate from what Google displays (#767).
  - **analytics** (2.0.2 → 2.0.3): GA4 enhanced-measurement event names in reports (#774), and localized price text kept out of monetary tracking (#779).
  - **churn-prevention** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): correct Paddle Billing dunning webhook events (#776).
  - **aso** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2): Google Play preview videos can autoplay muted (#784).
  - **seo-audit** (2.1.0 → 2.1.1): preferred canonicals for same-language regional duplicates, which must sit inside the hreflang cluster (#782).
  - **directory-submissions** (2.1.0 → 2.1.1): verify the actual link and its rel qualifiers rather than HTTP headers (#768).
- **Math and reasoning:**
  - **ab-testing** (2.0.0 → 2.0.1): correct p-value and confidence-interval interpretation for fixed-horizon tests (#769).
  - **ads** (2.4.5 → 2.4.6): CAC payback uses gross margin and cohort recovery, keeping firm verdicts (#773). The Meta Andromeda playbook moved into `references/meta-andromeda-playbook.md`, bringing SKILL.md under 500 lines.
  - **marketing-plan** (1.2.0 → 1.2.1): ARR budgets account for churn in the starting base (#772).
  - **pricing** (2.1.2 → 2.1.3): Van Westendorp measures price perception, not demand (#771).
  - **referrals** (2.0.2 → 2.1.0): rewards are capped by total CAC (#780). A new `references/affiliate-operations.md` covers cohort economics, partner activation, payout policy, and incrementality; it builds on @Adi29102000-s's contribution in #417 (#724).
  - **attribution** (1.1.2 → 1.1.3): stale booking-link identity is cleared (#770), and webhook analytics failures are non-fatal (#778).
- **Routing and creative:**
  - **cro** (2.0.1 → 2.0.2) and **emails** (2.1.2 → 2.1.3): a routing table that sends each question to the right reference (#699).
  - **ai-seo** (2.7.4 → 2.7.5): question-level routing to its references (#702).
  - **ad-creative** (2.9.4 → 2.10.0): headline treatments by buyer awareness stage (#727).
- **Tooling:** the validator and sync script now handle Windows line endings (#709), ignore indented metadata keys (#763), keep literal `$` text (#764), and require frontmatter that opens and closes the file (#762).

name: v2.11.22 — 75 CLI fixes from @rudycelekli, each checked against the vendor's current API docs. Endp…
body:
75 CLI fixes from @rudycelekli, each checked against the vendor's current API docs. Endpoints, auth, pagination, encoding, and error handling now match what the APIs actually accept.

- **Correct endpoints and payloads:** Dub (#661, #729), Beehiiv (#662, #663), SendGrid Single Sends (#664), Apollo org enrichment (#668), Amplitude retention (#670), SavvyCal (#671, #742), Livestorm (#672), Close (#673), Keywords Everywhere (#675), Pendo (#676), Intercom (#680, #686), Optimizely archive (#681), Hotjar (#682), Trustpilot invitations (#683), Similarweb v4 (#684), AirOps (#685), Tolt (#687), lemlist webhook filters (#689), Demio (#692), Ahrefs backlinks (#693), Crossbeam (#696), Rewardful (#698), Mailchimp tags (#701), Snov (#707, #752), Semrush backlinks (#711), PartnerStack (#723), Adobe (#741).
- **Auth:** ZoomInfo signed-key login (#690), Supermetrics (#691), Zapier catch hooks without management keys (#694), OneSignal `Key` auth (#695), Wistia Bearer (#706), Google Ads without a developer token, now that Google has sunset them (#718), Apollo key in a header (#668).
- **Failing loudly instead of silently:** GSC (#674), TikTok (#710), DataForSEO task errors (#714), Postmark partial batches (#715), Mixpanel ingestion (#716), GA4 event params (#700), Intercom metadata (#766).
- **Pagination and identifiers:** Klaviyo cursors (#666), Customer.io ID encoding and EU region (#665, #738), Plausible (#733), GA4 (#735), GSC (#736), Hunter (#746), Resend (#749), Close page size (#750), Rewardful (#754), Outreach cursors (#755), Pendo IDs (#728), Apollo employee ranges (#765), github-prospects truncation (#708), Buffer `--now false` (#704).
- **New capabilities:** Amplitude external-ID lookup and device-only events (#726, #758), Paddle plan and billing-date changes (#731), Firecrawl crawl errors (#734), ActiveCampaign custom fields (#737), Segment anonymous IDs and delivery metadata (#739, #760), Google Ads read-only GAQL (#743), Brevo channel suppression (#745), Exa answers and structured search output (#747, #753), Resend idempotency keys (#748), Postmark template models (#756), Klaviyo structured properties (#757), Customer.io suppression (#759).
- **Interface changes to know about:**
  - `amplitude users activity --user-id` now takes your external user ID; use `--amplitude-id` for Amplitude's internal ID (#726).
  - `airops --id` is now the app UUID, and `AIROPS_WORKSPACE_ID` is no longer used (#685).
  - Tolt drops `--name`, `--commission-rate`, `payouts`, and customer lookup by `--customer-id` (#687).
  - ZoomInfo passwords move from `ZOOMINFO_PRIVATE_KEY` to `ZOOMINFO_PASSWORD` (#690).
  - OneSignal switches to `Key` auth, so check older-format keys (#695).
  - PartnerStack `transactions create` and `webhooks create` require `--currency` and `--events` (#723).
  - `mailchimp` rejects `--tags` combined with other update flags (#701).
  - DataForSEO exits 1 on "no results" and "partial results" task codes as well as errors (#714).

body: Release 0.163.0-alpha.2

## New Features

- Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)
- Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)
- Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)
- Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)
- Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)
- Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

## Bug Fixes

- Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)
- Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)
- Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)
- Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)
- Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)
- Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)

## Chores

- Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
- Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

name: v5.1.28
body:
**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10-10.** With several Anthropic Subscription accounts, a session no longer switches accounts on a transient error and back on the next turn; it retries the same account, then stays on whichever account holds its transcript. With `resumeMode: "off"`, the conversation is no longer written to the prompt cache again on every turn. A long streamed tool call on the Anthropic Subscription lane no longer fails with "session stream queue exceeded 256 messages". Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-10](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-10). ([senpi#2891](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2891), [senpi#2982](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2982), [senpi#2822](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2822), [#9798](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9798))

**Search, docs and quick work now run on Claude Haiku 5.5.** The default `explore`, `librarian` and `quick` lineups use `claude-haiku-5-5` at medium reasoning, right after GPT-6 Luna Fast, instead of Claude Haiku 4.5 at the end of the chain. On an Anthropic-only machine, the memory and Kibitzer sidecars run on it too. The Claude Code `haiku` alias now means Haiku 5.5. ([#9802](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9802))

**Approval and authorization questions can't be read as permission, whichever model asks them.** ulw-plan's approval gate, its authorization block and mass-ulw's scope, spend and irreversible decisions are asked with `required: true`, so an unanswered gate ends the turn instead of continuing on best judgment. The plugin also sets the flag itself on gating questions, recognized by their pinned headers, for models that leave it out. ([#9735](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9735), [#9775](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9775), [#9774](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9774), [#9782](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9782))

**`chatgpt-subscription/gpt-6.1-sol-ultrafast` is available without a local extension**, with the Ultrafast service tier and default `xhigh` reasoning. Thanks to @audreyt. ([senpi#2975](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2975))

### Fixed

**A config migration no longer reformats your `omo.jsonc`.** The first start against an existing config rewrote every top-level value, dropping nested comments, trailing commas and your formatting. Migrations now edit only the values they change, in the file's own style. ([#9777](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9777), [#9783](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9783))

**A child that won't stop no longer keeps finished children resident.** One child that ignored SIGTERM stalled the idle sweep, so finished process children piled up (about 2 GB each). Every teardown step is now bounded, idle residents are reclaimed one by one, and `task_cancel` releases a finished resident; cancelling a running child that never answers its abort no longer hangs either. Thanks to @lee98www for the report. ([#9785](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9785), [#9788](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9788), [#9791](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9791), [#9792](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9792))

**Binary downloads validate every archive entry on localized systems.** Tar listings in a non-English locale (localized month names) or from GNU tar were not parsed, so their entries skipped validation; the downloader now lists archives in the C locale, parses both formats, and refuses a listing line it can't parse. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([#9685](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9685), [#9780](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9780), [#9779](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9779))

**A suspended background task no longer looks like it is working.** Its row in the live task widget shows a still mark instead of a spinner and no climbing timer, names why it stopped (for example, the parent session restarted), and offers a message only where sending one would revive it. ([#9350](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9350), [#9795](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9795))

**Memory no longer writes empty transcript journals.** A session with nothing to record wrote an empty journal at every start; none is written now, and empty journals left by older builds are removed. ([#9737](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9737), [#9739](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9739))

name: v5.1.27
body:
**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10-9, which stops automatic turns from running without bound.** After one message from you, stream-rule nudges, goal continuations and other automatic follow-ups pause after 150 turns, or once 12 automatic turns in a minute do no work, and each stream rule corrects a message at most once. When it pauses, the session says so, and your next message picks it back up. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-9](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-9). ([senpi#2967](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2967), [senpi#2969](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2969), [#9772](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9772))

**A required question can't be read as permission.** senpi's `ask_user_question` accepts `required: true` for a question that gates an action, such as an approval before an irreversible step: if it times out, is dismissed or can't be shown, the model is told not to take that action. ([senpi#2949](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2949), [senpi#2959](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2959))

**The configuration guide documents the Anthropic 1-hour prompt cache and the cache keep-alive.** ([#9770](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9770), [#9771](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9771))

### Fixed

**Memory locks stop churning on machines with many sessions.** A session waiting on a memory lock no longer republishes a recovery lock on every retry: it reads first, and lock polls back off with jitter instead of a fixed 25 ms. Locks and candidate files left by processes that died are reclaimed, so the lock directory stops growing. ([#9749](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9749), [#9750](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9750))

**Single-turn answers no longer carry the progress-ledger block.** Hephaestus and Sisyphus keep the Now/Next ledger for multi-step work tracked in todos; a request finished in one turn gets a plain answer, without lines such as `Next: none`. Thanks to @cynkai. ([#9616](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9616), [#9676](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9676))

**A provider that sets its own `anthropic-beta` header keeps the betas a request needs**, so Claude 5.5 models through such a route no longer fail their first call. ([senpi#2957](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2957), [senpi#2963](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2963))

**Deprecating platform packages for a release that never shipped rechecks the registry before failing**, so a deprecation that is still propagating no longer fails the workflow. ([#9769](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9769))

name: v5.1.26
body:
5.1.25 was not released: its Linux x64 binaries went over the 150 MiB per-binary size budget during publishing, so no `omo-ai`, `lazycodex-ai`, `oh-my-opencode` or `oh-my-openagent` 5.1.25 exists. Everything planned for it ships here. Some 5.1.25 platform packages did reach npm and are deprecated; nothing installs them.

**omo runs on senpi 2026.10.10-8, which keeps a saved MCP sign-in with the authorization server that issued it.** The bundled MCP SDK moves to 1.32.1 (GHSA-6qxp-vccf-f47h), and senpi records which authorization server issued each saved sign-in and refreshes only there. If an MCP server's authorization server changes, you are asked to sign in again instead. MCP servers signed in with very old senpi versions may ask you to sign in again once their access token expires. An MCP HTTP endpoint that redirects to a different origin is no longer followed, and the connect error names both origins and the URL to put in the server's config. Full engine notes: [senpi 2026.10.10-8](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/releases/tag/v2026.10.10-8). ([senpi#2940](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2940), [senpi#2944](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2944), [#9757](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9757))

**A relayed report or a quoted mention no longer turns on ultrawork.** A message that opens with a sender header (`[REPORT]`, `[a -> b]`, `Name (id) to recipient:`), a Markdown block quote, or a double-quoted span is now read as someone else's words, so pasting a report that describes ultrawork into a session no longer arms it there. A skill name inside an identifier, a path, a URL, or a prohibition ("no ultrawork", "do not use mass-ulw") no longer arms ultrawork or a skill pointer either. Typed asks, such as "ulw <task>" or a keyword at the end of your own sentence, still arm. ([#9600](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9600), [#9606](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9606), [#9738](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9738), [#9740](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9740), [#9744](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9744))

**An opt-in side panel for the Senpi TUI.** Set `side_panel.enabled: true` in `omo.json` (or pass `--omo-side-panel` for one run) to get a right-hand column with the session, goal, context, subagents, tools, changed files and memory at a glance; the transcript reflows beside it, and clicking a file row opens its diff. Subscription usage is a separate opt-in (`side_panel.sections.usage`) because it is the one section that reads credentials. It is off by default and hides itself on terminals narrower than 120 columns. Thanks to @IvoryKir. ([#8092](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/8092))

**A bundled `visualize` skill renders inline HTML pages.** Charts, tables, diagrams and mockups come back as a self-contained page shown in the session; where the html preview is not available, the skill opens the page file through the browser skill instead. ([#9700](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9700), [#9702](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9702))

**Arch Linux users can install OmO from the community AUR package `omo-bin`.** The install guide now documents it: `yay -S omo-bin` (or any AUR helper) installs the official Linux binary from our GitHub releases after checking it against the release's `SHA256SUMS`. It's maintained by @sTiKyt, not the OmO team, so update it with your AUR helper rather than `omo update`. ([#9584](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9584), [#9610](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9610))

### Fixed

**The release binary size budget is 160 MiB, and every build reports its headroom.** Linux x64 reached 157.6 MB, over the old 150 MiB budget, which stopped 5.1.25. The budget exists to keep each install and update download small; release builds now print each target's headroom and warn when one is within 5 MiB of the budget. ([#9760](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9760))

**A task child spawned with an explicit model runs on that model, or the spawn fails and says why.** A pin with a thinking level such as `anthropic/claude-opus-5-5:medium` used to be dropped silently, so the child ran on the default model instead; the pin is now resolved once against the live model registry, and the child's own reported model is checked after it starts. A model that cannot be resolved, or a child that comes up on a different model, fails the spawn with a typed error, and `task_output` shows the model the child actually ran next to the one requested. ([#9722](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9722), [#9736](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9736))

**The planner asks its approval question through the question tool.** `ulw-plan` and `mass-ulw` ask owner decisions and the plan-approval gate as a real question instead of chat text, and a dismissed or timed-out approval writes no plan. ([#9735](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9735), [#9748](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9748))

**Delegated task children stay out of ultrawork orchestration.** A child spawned to do one piece of work no longer starts orchestrating its own team when its brief mentions ultrawork. Thanks to @Dante-dan. ([#9600](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9600), [#9602](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9602))

**A process-runner task child gets its own model fallback chain.** A child running as a separate process now falls back the same way an in-process child does, and its start never waits on that setup: if the chain is refused or not answered within 10 seconds it warns and sends the prompt anyway. ([#9582](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9582), [#9587](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9587))

**A suspended task child is revived or ended after its session is resumed.** When a resumed session finds a child it could not revive right away, it retries with backoff, and a child that still cannot be revived is marked lost with the last reason and the retry count, so the parent is notified instead of waiting forever. ([#9498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9498), [#9714](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9714))

**omo sees every model senpi lists.** omo's background check of which models a task child may use read `senpi --list-models` through a pipe that the engine could close before the whole list arrived, so models late in the list (xAI's, for example) could be refused as unknown. The list is now read from a file. ([#9068](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9068), [#9745](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9745))

**The slash picker lists each bundled skill once.** The bare alias takes the place of its `skill:<name>` row instead of appearing next to it. ([#9648](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9648), [#9650](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9650))

**A session started in your home folder no longer migrates `.sisyphus` into `~/.omo`.** The legacy workspace migration refuses the home target and never overwrites an existing file, so the OmO desktop's data under `~/.omo/desktop` is never touched. ([#9727](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9727), [#9731](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9731))

**Engine fixes in senpi 2026.10.10-8.**
- An Anthropic subscription account blocked by an authentication error recovers on its own when its saved refresh token is still accepted, instead of every request failing with "blocked until re-login". ([senpi#2926](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2926))
- A long, tool-heavy turn on a small context window, such as Claude Haiku 5.5's 100K, no longer ends with "compaction did not complete": the earlier steps of the turn are summarized and the latest one is kept. ([senpi#2925](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2925))
- The reasoning effort you pick for Claude Opus 5 / 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1 now reaches Anthropic; it was always sent as `high`. ([senpi#2912](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2912))
- A model picked in the terminal applies to that session only instead of silently changing the default; press Ctrl+S in the picker or type `/model <id> --default` to make it the default. ([senpi#2870](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2870))
- A fallback model whose context window cannot hold the session no longer ends the fallback; the next model in the chain is tried. ([senpi#2894](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2894))
- `senpi --list-models`, `--version`, `--help` and `--export` no longer lose output when their stdout is a slowly read pipe. omo's own model probe was hit by this (fewer models listed than exist). ([senpi#2937](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2937), [senpi#2939](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2939))
- An `ask_user_question` answer is no longer put inside the tool result, where models that treat tool results as untrusted (Claude Haiku 5.5) may ignore it; the answer reaches the model as your own message. ([senpi#2920](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2920))
- Children that senpi starts from a script no longer re-run a caller that embeds senpi from `node -e` or `bun -e`. Thanks to @MoerAI. ([senpi#2599](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2599), [senpi#2950](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2950))
- Kimi K3 cache writes on Moonshot's API and in the Kimi Coding estimate are priced at the official $3 per million tokens; they were counted as free. ([senpi#2954](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/pull/2954))
- A config hot reload no longer loops on omo's `omo.jsonc`. ([senpi#2878](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2878))
- Paths the OmO desktop moved with its data home are refused with their new location instead of being written to. ([senpi#2898](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2898))
- Claude Haiku 5.5 is available on Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway and Venice, with its own system prompt. ([senpi#2892](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2892), [senpi#2917](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/senpi/issues/2917))

name: CC Switch v4.0.6
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.6

### 4.0 正式版的第二个修复版本

供应商页的页头多了搜索按钮，还能按请求地址查找。Skills 检查到更新后可以一键全部更新，确认前会列出要更新的 Skill。额度数字的绿、橙、红三色回来了，剩余不足 20% 就会变色提醒。Codex 聚合模式下，主 agent 和子 agent 用不同供应商时子 agent 读不到任务，现在可以打开新开关改用经典子 agent 工具。这个版本还修复了 Claude Code 经路由转 OpenAI Chat 格式时最后一段回复丢失、Codex 聚合模式下官方模型消失、托盘看不到火山等 5 小时额度等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.6-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.6-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**供应商页加了搜索按钮。** 以前只能按 ⌘F / Ctrl+F 打开搜索，很多人不知道有这个功能。现在「添加供应商」旁边有搜索按钮，除了名称、备注和官网，也能按请求地址查找。关掉搜索框后列表会恢复完整，不会再停在筛选结果上。不需要这个按钮的话，可以在「设置 → 通用 → 侧栏与页头」关掉「显示供应商搜索」，快捷键照样能用。

**Skills 一键更新全部。** 以前要先检查更新，再把列表筛到「可更新」，再到筛选栏里找「全部更新」。现在检查到更新后，「检查更新」按钮会直接变成「全部更新（N 个）」，确认框会列出每个要更新的 Skill 和它的来源仓库。确认后对话框马上关闭，按钮上显示更新进度。重新检查放到了「…」菜单里。

**额度数字的颜色回来了。** 4.0 把额度文字都改成了灰色，额度充足还是快用完很难一眼看出来。现在恢复 3.x 的绿、橙、红三色，只给数字上色，档位名称和「剩余」两个字仍是灰色。剩余不足 20% 就会变色提醒（以前是 10%），托盘里的「快用完」也按 20% 算。

**Codex 聚合模式可以让子 agent 用经典工具。** Codex 新版的子 agent 工具会把主 agent 交代的任务交给主 agent 所在的服务商加密，子 agent 换到另一家供应商就解不开，只能报错或拿到空任务。在「设置 → 应用配置 → Codex」打开「聚合模式下子 agent 用经典工具」后，聚合里的所有模型改用 Codex 经典的子 agent 工具，任务以明文传递；代价是没有 `followup_task`、`interrupt_agent` 等新版功能。开关默认关闭，只影响聚合模式，改完要重启 Codex。开关关闭时遇到这种情况，CC Switch 会直接返回错误说明原因并提示这个开关，不再让子 agent 带着空任务运行，也不再让 Codex 反复重试。

**Codex 切换账号后会提示重启后台服务。** Codex 的后台服务不一定会重新读取登录信息，切换账号后可能还在用切换前的账号。以前只有聚合模式下模型列表变了才会提示重启，现在直连、路由、聚合三种模式下切换了账号都会提示，点按钮确认后才会重启后台服务；用 Codex 桌面版或编辑器插件时，提示完全退出后重新打开。

**CC Switch 有新版本时，侧栏「设置」上的提示点改成绿色**，点「设置」会直接打开「关于」页。「应用」上的工具更新提示点保持原样。

## 修复

- **Claude Code 经路由转换到 OpenAI Chat 格式的供应商时，最后一段回复整段丢失。** 有的上游在结束时不发送结束原因，或者发完结束原因后又补了一段内容，转换后的最后一段文字或工具调用没有正确结束，Claude Code 会丢掉这段内容，还会触发重试。
- **Codex 聚合模式下，带有网页搜索记录的会话压缩上下文时报 502。** 压缩时 CC Switch 会删掉请求里的工具定义，但历史记录里还有网页搜索、函数调用这些工具调用，部分上游会直接拒绝这样的请求。现在压缩时保留工具定义，并要求模型这一轮不调用工具。
- **Codex 聚合模式下，官方账号设为默认后，`/model` 里只剩第三方模型。** CC Switch 按 PATH 里 `codex` 命令的版本去拉官方模型列表，官方对 0.140 及更早的版本只返回隐藏的模型。只用 Codex 桌面版的用户 PATH 里常常留着旧版命令行，官方模型就全被隐藏了。现在按本机实际在用的最新版本去拉（命令行、桌面版、编辑器插件都算）。如果拉到的列表里没有可显示的模型，会改用 CC Switch 自带的列表，并提示升级 Codex。
- **Codex 用路由转 Chat 格式的第三方供应商或 GitHub Copilot 时，模型目录会跟着官方条目的改动变化。** 以前 CC Switch 照着 Codex 本地缓存的官方 gpt-5.5 条目生成这类模型的目录，官方每次改这个条目（比如设为隐藏、换成新的工具形态）都会带到第三方模型上；缓存还写明 GPT-5.5 将在 10 月 14 日下线，下线后每次切换都要额外启动一次 Codex 命令行。现在一律使用 CC Switch 自带的模板。
- **删除托管的 ChatGPT 账号或全部登出后，绑定这个账号的 Codex 供应商无法切换。** 这些供应商还指着已删除的账号。现在删除或登出时会一起解除绑定，供应商改为跟随 Codex 自己的登录。供应商会随云同步，所以只解除本机账号的绑定，其他设备上的账号绑定不受影响。
- **用 npm 安装的 Claude Code，在 macOS、Linux 上通过「应用」页升级后无法运行。** 上一版修好了 npm 12 下的安装，但升级时调用的 `claude update` 仍会被 npm 12 拦下安装脚本，同时提示升级成功。现在升级时也允许安装脚本运行。Windows 和 WSL 的升级路径这次没有改。
- **Skills 导入对话框关不掉。** 打开过「发现」页的话，导入时要等「发现」列表从 GitHub 全部重新下载完，网络慢时对话框会一直卡住，无法取消或关闭。
- **托盘里火山、智谱、MiniMax 等有三档额度的供应商，看不到 5 小时额度。** 托盘只显示剩余最少的两档，5 小时额度重置最勤、通常剩得最多，几乎总被省掉。现在和 3.x 一样显示全部档位。
- **浅色模式下，「应用」页「显示」列的开关分不清开和关。** 打开时是深灰、关闭时是中灰，现在改用和其他开关一样的颜色。

**其他：**
- 新增中文版聚合模式指南，用户手册补充了获取模型列表、models.dev 补全参数和手动填写的区别。
- 三语用户手册更新了 Linux 应用级窗口按钮的设置路径。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

**Codex 经路由使用 Chat 格式第三方供应商或 GitHub Copilot 的会话**，升级后继续之前的会话时会自动压缩一次上下文。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @SailingLoong（Claude Code 经路由时最后一段回复丢失）、@ggbdpq（聚合模式压缩上下文报 502）、@Komikawayi（Codex 切换账号后的重启提示）、@CacinieP（npm 12 下升级 Claude Code）、@SaladDay（报告并最早修复删除账号后绑定悬空）、@ljie-PI（Codex GitHub Copilot 供应商的后续整理）、@Lingbou（发布流程检查 Linux 安装包）、@Railgun-wiki（用户手册更新）的贡献。

感谢 @zjyzhj、@Camsyn、@Tison6、@fpga-go、@j1406493495、@RichardZhengkay、@spancerxing、@HansYeoh 报告问题和提出建议。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: CC Switch v4.0.5
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.5

### 4.0 正式版的第一个修复版本

Codex 现在可以用 GitHub Copilot 账号了。用量统计的「全部」热力图不再只显示最近一年，可以一直往前看到第一天的记录。这个版本还修复了 Claude Code 经 Responses 协议映射到 GPT 时子代理总被派去 worktree、Codex 聚合模式下 GLM 等模型在 `/model` 里消失的问题，Linux 的 deb、rpm 安装包也能应用内更新了。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 [v4.0 发布说明](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.4-zh.md)。

> **Linux deb、rpm 用户请手动安装这一版。** 已经装好的 deb、rpm 版本还带着旧的安装类型标记，应用内更新到这一版仍会提示权限不足。手动下载安装一次 4.0.5 之后，以后就能正常自动更新。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.5-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.5-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

**Codex 可以用 GitHub Copilot 账号。** 在 Codex 添加供应商时选「GitHub Copilot」预设，在「授权中心」登录 GitHub 账号即可；Claude Code 已经登录过的 Copilot 账号可以直接用。需要开启 Codex 的路由。Copilot 上不同模型支持的协议不一样，本地路由会按模型自动选择 Responses 或 Chat Completions，也可以在编辑器的「上游格式」里手动指定。不同账号等级的上下文窗口不同，预设默认取较保守的值，点「获取模型列表」会按你账号的实际窗口和推理档位填好模型目录。

**「全部」热力图可以看完整历史。** 以前时间范围选「全部」时，热力图只显示最近 53 周。现在默认仍是最近 53 周，点「显示更多」会每 53 周一段往前排，一直到有记录的第一天；每段标出日期范围、Token 数、请求数和花费，各段的颜色深浅可以直接对比。

## 修复

- **Claude Code 经 Responses 协议映射到 GPT 时，子代理总被派去 worktree。** Claude Code 调用子代理时，「隔离方式」和「模型」是可选参数，但 Responses 协议在没有明确说明时会把可选参数当成必填，模型每次都会填上。结果子代理被派到 worktree 里运行，不在 git 仓库里就直接失败，或者子代理自己配置的模型被覆盖。现在转换时会明确声明这些参数可选。用 Responses 协议的供应商和 ChatGPT 账号都受影响，现在都修好了。
- **Codex 聚合模式下，GLM 等模型在 `/model` 里看不到。** CC Switch 生成模型目录时会以官方的 gpt-5.5 条目为模板，官方把这个条目设为隐藏后，聚合里的第三方模型也跟着全被隐藏了，聚合计数却还在算它们。
- **Codex 的模力方舟预设在 `/model` 里只有一个模型。** 预设没有带模型目录，Codex 只列出默认模型。现在 5 个模型都会列出来，并带上上下文窗口、图片输入和推理档位。已经添加的模力方舟供应商不会自动更新，需要重新从预设添加一次。
- **Linux 上用 deb、rpm 安装的版本，应用内更新提示权限不足。** 以前更新器认不出 deb、rpm 安装，按 AppImage 的方式往 `/usr/bin` 里写文件。现在 deb、rpm 有了各自的更新包。已经装好的版本要先手动装一次这一版，见上方的提示。
- **Linux Wayland 下，标题栏的最小化、最大化、关闭按钮点了没反应。** 第一次打开窗口时，或者从托盘重新打开窗口后，按钮上会盖着一层看不见的区域。
- **Windows 用 MSI 升级后，任务栏上固定的图标在重启电脑后变成空白。** 快捷方式以前指向一个每次升级都会被删掉的图标缓存，现在直接用程序本身的图标。之前固定的图标在这次升级后可能还会变白一次，取消固定再重新固定一次就好，以后升级不会再出现。
- **用 npm 12 安装 Claude Code 后无法运行，Windows 上提示程序不兼容。** npm 12 默认不运行 Claude Code 的安装脚本，却照样提示安装成功，留下的只是一个占位文件。现在「应用」页的安装、升级，以及可以复制的安装命令都会允许这个安装脚本运行。
- **没开路由时，Grok Build 的用量要等 10 分钟才出现在用量统计里**，现在 1 分钟左右。

**其他：**
- 用户手册和 README 更新到 4.0 的界面。

## 升级说明

**数据库结构没有变化**，仍然是 20。

**Linux deb、rpm 用户请手动安装这一版**，之后就能正常自动更新。

**Windows 用户**：如果升级后任务栏上固定的图标变成空白，取消固定再重新固定一次即可。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @ljie-PI（Codex 接入 GitHub Copilot，与 @ump45nose 共同完成）、@SailingLoong（子代理不再被派去 worktree）、@cenglin123（聚合模式下 GLM 模型消失）、@lcgash（模力方舟模型目录）、@Lingbou（Linux deb、rpm 自动更新）、@Railgun-wiki（Wayland 标题栏按钮）、@Besty0728（Windows 任务栏图标）、@funkpopo（npm 12 安装 Claude Code，以及模力方舟预设的审查）的贡献。

感谢 @Timetraps-x、@ggbdpq、@c2519352073-star、@yukitakasama、@liuziyuan、@Suaig 为同样的问题提交了修复或实现。

感谢 @WK-Apollo、@caoguanjie、@kirkchinese、@ZMKC404、@sunwayking、@Vistonz、@van23qf、@echoescheng、@xlht4106、@YueZhang2019、@hueifeng、@jingzhang94 报告问题和提出建议。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-08.

### Enhancements

- Remove orphaned temporary build environments with `uv cache prune` ([#22171](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22171))
- Accept PEP 508 marker operators directly before grouped expressions ([#22309](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22309))
- Reject malformed requirements-file options instead of partially parsing or ignoring them ([#22317](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22317))
- Show underlying filesystem and registry errors when managed Python uninstallation fails ([#22362](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22362))
- Identify the invalid source URL in Python mirror errors ([#22364](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22364))

### Preview features

- Display preferred advisory IDs in `uv audit` reports, prioritizing PYSEC, GHSA, then CVE identifiers ([#22292](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22292))

### Configuration

- Support custom installation mirrors for GraalPy ([#22269](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22269))
- Support custom installation mirrors for Pyodide ([#22271](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22271))
- Allow `UV_NO_CACHE=false` to override `no-cache = true` in configuration ([#22324](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22324))
- Report more precise error locations for invalid trusted-host ports and preview-feature list entries ([#22144](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22144))

### Performance

- Speed up later commands after creating an environment by warming its interpreter cache ([#21304](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/21304))
- Reduce code-signature verification work for ARM64 macOS releases with 16 KiB signature pages ([#22246](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22246))
- Enforce resource limits when parsing package indexes and `--find-links` pages with `astral-html` ([#22203](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22203))
- Reduce standalone `uv-build` executable size by 7.5% by omitting unused Zstandard support ([#22242](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22242))
- Reduce uv's binary size by about 232 KB by simplifying configuration deserialization ([#22144](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22144))
- Reduce Python download error formatting code size by sharing its formatter ([#22141](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22141))

### Bug fixes

- Verify supplied hashes even when hash presence is disabled with `--no-require-hashes` or `require-hashes = false` ([#22369](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22369))
- Honor exact managed Python patch pins when creating script environments instead of following patch upgrades ([#22360](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22360))
- Prevent dependency overrides and constraints from activating optional dependencies when their extras are not selected ([#22237](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22237))
- Exclude optional dependencies from exports when their extras are activated only in incompatible environments ([#22234](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22234))
- Give explicit `uv publish --trusted-publishing` values precedence over configuration ([#22279](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22279))
- Allow `UV_OFFLINE=false` to override `offline = true` in configuration ([#22283](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22283))
- Allow `UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=false` to override `system-certs = true` in configuration ([#22291](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22291))
- Allow `uv auth login` over IPv6 loopback addresses ([#22306](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22306))
- Resolve GitHub dependencies whose Git references contain `#` or `%` characters ([#22281](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22281))
- Recognize existing Pyodide interpreters as satisfying Pyodide Python requests ([#22322](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22322))
- Preserve JSON output from `uv version` and `uv self version` with a single `--quiet` flag ([#22280](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22280))
- Preserve trailing spaces and tabs in passwords returned by subprocess keyrings ([#22284](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22284))
- Restore wheel incompatibility hints when `WHEEL` metadata contains multiple expanded `Tag:` rows ([#22235](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22235))
- Preserve Windows wheel-script rename errors unless a cross-drive copy fallback applies ([#22302](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22302))
- Prevent workspace-cache assertion failures after modifying a project at the workspace root ([#22236](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22236))
- Hide the ignored `--keyring-provider` option from `uv auth` help ([#19520](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/19520))
- Report HTTP client setup failures directly when resolving unnamed `uv tool` requirements ([#22320](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22320))

### Documentation

- Update Docker and AWS Lambda examples to cache dependency layers using frozen lockfiles without project manifests ([#22172](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22172))
- Fix stale links and descriptions in Rust crate documentation ([#22311](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22311), [#22361](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22361))
- Fix a typo in the `required-environments` documentation ([#22238](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22238))

## Install uv 0.12.24

